words.meaning: Pure in motive. See Mark 10:17; Romans 5:7 (absolute sense of God). Superior to
words.plain: A good man [Greek: agathos] means good in motive — pure from the inside out, not just in outward behavior. Paul uses this word in Romans 5:7 in the absolute sense, reserved for God himself. When the crowds call Jesus 'a good man,' they're using a word that carries more weight than they realize.
